g.text: Session id (asn_ + ULID); one row per refresh token generation.
OTA currently selected in the console for this session.
SHA-256 of the opaque refresh token (the token itself is never stored).
Rotation family: all tokens issued from one login; reuse of a rotated token revokes the family.
Next token of the rotation chain.
Login e-mail of the portal user (unique case-insensitively).
OTA the key may act for.
Owner/admin of the OTA who granted it.
Tenant resolved from the key (NULL only for hosting keys, which act for the OTAs in api_key_...
Portal account that owns a hosting key (required for kind hosting, NULL otherwise).
pk_ (browser-safe, customer scope), sk_ (server-only) or hk_ (server-only, one deployment se...
test = Amadeus test connection, live = production.
Visible lookup prefix, e.g. pk_live_3fA9x2 (first 14 chars of the key).
HMAC-SHA-256 of the full key with a server pepper.
Natural key of the plan, e.g. starter, growth, enterprise.
False = legacy plan, kept for existing subscriptions only.
Dotted action name, e.g. api_key.revoked, tenant.suspended.
Current step, e.g. create_schema, run_migrations, seed_defaults, issue_api_keys, activate.
Subscribed tenant (billing records are never cascaded away).
End of the current billing period.
OAuth2 client id (API key) issued by Amadeus.
Office used when the caller does not choose one (queues, PNR lookup).
Fully qualified host name, lower case (unique).
OTA the person is invited to.
SHA-256 of the invitation token sent by e-mail.
Staff id (stf_ + ULID); subject of staff tokens, referenced by value in tenant staff_actions.
Console role of the account in this OTA.
Who invited this member (NULL for the founder).
Immutable short key; used for the schema name and the <key>.velexis.app host.
Name of the tenant schema (always tenant_<key>).
Lifecycle; only active tenants are served.
Current plan (denormalised from the active subscription).
Data residency region of the tenant.
PostgreSQL cluster that hosts the tenant schema (shard key for routing).
Latest tenant migration applied to the schema (mirror of tenant_schema_migrations).
Portal account that signed up and created the OTA.
